{{Quote|We Selonians do not trust outsiders easily, or often ask outsiders for help, but you have done well and have earned our respect.|The den mother, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AtDM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Address the Den Mother|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Neetha Den''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Den (Selonian)|den]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Descrition==
[[File:Selonian_cave_Talus.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Neetha Den's cave]].]]
{{Quote|You need to understand that they do not welcome outside help easily. You're likely to meet unfriendly Selonians during your tasks. Do not let them affect the completion of your tasks. Selonians are a very unemotional race, it may seem that they are ungrateful, but the truth is they will be deeply indebted to you.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref>}}
The Neetha Den lived on Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Selonians inhabited a [[Neetha Den's cave|cave]] near the city of [[Nashal]]. The den was led by the [[den mother]] [[Kiisa Kimotte]] and included the [[sept]] [[Kiki Dorente]], advisor to the den mother,<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> [[Tika Sileste]],<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Exploiting a Weakness|Talus}}</ref> [[Ravi Thienta]],<ref name="SWG:UYT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Under Your Thumb" on Talus</ref> and [[Lika Fimente]].<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Gather the Missing|Talus}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Askura deal was proposed by a den mate that precipitated the smugglers' exploitation of our den. It allowed a group of our mates to be taken prisoner and held as hostages to get us to mine for the smugglers.|The [[Kiisa Kimotte|Neetha den mother]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AtDM" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a member of the den proposed the so-named Askura deal, a partnership with a group of [[Talusian Smugglers|Talusian smugglers]] based nearby. However, the deal was fake and the Selonians were soon exploited by the smugglers.<ref name="SWG:AtDM" /> Several Selonians of the den were captured by the smugglers and kept as hostages in order to force the rest of the den into mining for them.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The situation generated [[Anti-Humanism|anti-human]] sentiments among the Selonian population of Talus and hostile anti-human demonstrations erupted in the city of Nashal. Despite no act of violence against Humans was reported, the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] and the [[Cluster World Relations]] agency issued a travel warning for Nashal. Via [[Corellia News Service]], [[Marx Grocco]], Director of Cluster World Relations, explained that this preventive measure was meant to insure the public safety of Talusian human citizens and human travelers for any possible hostile encounters with non-human protestors.<ref name="web">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66901&resource=features|text=Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives}}</ref>

[[File:Smuggler_Base.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Smuggler Base]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] discovered the situation but was unable to intervene because Selonians refused that [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] might be involved in their matters. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] thus recruited an independent spacer in order to help the Selonians without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer met Kiki Dorente, the advisor to the den mother, in the den's cave and the Selonian accepted the assistance.<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> Dorente first tasked the spacer to reconnoiter the [[Smuggler Base]] where her den mates where supposedly held. After the spacer successfully returned with the information requested, Kiki and other Selonian mates developed a strategy against the smugglers.<ref name="SWG:FaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Finding a Weakness|Talus}}</ref> Tika Sileste requested the spacer to eliminate the smuggler guards and destroy the droids in the base.<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> Ravi Thienta asked the spacer to recover stolen Selonian's supplies and destroy the smugglers weapons cache.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> Lika Fimente tasked the spacer to find the captive Selonians in the base.<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> Furthermore, Kiki Dorente sent back the spacer to the smuggler base in order to gather information about the destination of the cargo shuttles leaving the base.<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> Although the spacer achieved most of the objectives, the assault was only a partial success. The spacer defeated most of the smugglers, including their leader,<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> and crippled their ability to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> However, the spacer discovered that the captive Selonians had already been shipped to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. The spacer also discovered that a traitor in the Selonian den intentionally helped the smugglers.<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> As the situation with the smugglers was concluding, the spacer was eventually awarded the title of den mate by the den mother.<ref name="SWG:AtDM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neetha Den appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Neetha Den was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
